locator.title: Топ-6 аттракционов в «Острове Мечты» для фаната экстрима
locator.caption: Это первая в России катальная гора с VR-технологией — попробуйте и без очков, и с ними

nearest_text_before.text: Но это еще не все. Возьмите VR-очки* за дополнительную плату. Надеваете их — и вместо рельсов парка оказываетесь за рулем болида на трассе футуристического города. Каждый маневр кабинки ощущается как вираж на бешеной скорости между зданиями.

image_reading: A bright red roller-coaster car carrying three riders travels on elevated red rails inside a dark themed indoor park.
The car is positioned left of center, with a sweeping curved track leading across the foreground and blue-white hanging crystal lights behind it.
The visible motion cues are the forward-facing car, track curvature and slight blur; the indoor themed setting remains a stable backdrop.
analysis.article_context: Body image for the sixth-place attraction “Race of the Future”: it introduces the VR-enabled indoor coaster and supports the article’s promise of fast, unpredictable turns and adrenaline.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A vivid first taste of the indoor VR coaster’s fast, unpredictable thrill.
structured_intent.primary_action: The red coaster car travels swiftly through the elevated curve with its riders.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The red car is visibly rounding the rightward curve, with all seated riders still recognizable.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The ride remains an exhilarating but controlled indoor attraction experience.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the coaster immediately gains steady speed through the visible elevated curve. Keep the camera fixed so the red car and three seated riders remain the focal point; the hanging lights show only a restrained passing shimmer. The car reaches the rightward bend near the end, still fully readable in frame, with its momentum continuing through the last frame.
models.positive_prompt: The red coaster car accelerates smoothly along the elevated curve toward the right, the riders braced in their seats while the crystal lights streak subtly past. Fixed camera. In the final moment, the car is clearly rounding the rightward bend with every rider still visible.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, let the red car enter the motion at once and build through one continuous run along the foreground rail. A fixed viewpoint emphasizes its approach to the bend and preserves the riders as a single readable group. The travel culminates late as the car settles into the visible right-hand curve, without introducing another movement.
models.positive_prompt: The red roller-coaster car carries its seated riders through the elevated curve at a steadily building pace; blue crystal lights trail softly behind it. Fixed view on the car. End with the car committed to the right-hand bend, riders and rails clearly visible.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, use a compact, even acceleration of the red car along the existing curve. Hold a fixed composition centered on the car and its passengers, with slight environmental light flow supporting the sense of speed. The final frames show the car visibly turning into the rightward bend, still fully present and recognizable.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the red coaster car as it races smoothly along the elevated curved rail, with a subtle flowing shimmer in the hanging lights. Finish with the car rounding the rightward bend while all seated riders remain visible.
